home.title: Taqwa · Prayer times & Quran app · Free, no ads, open source
home.og_title: Taqwa · Prayer times, Qibla and the Quran
home.description: Free, open-source Islamic app for Android and iPhone: prayer times, adhan, Qibla, the Quran with recitation and a tasbeeh. No ads, no account, works offline.

support.title: Support · Taqwa
support.description: How to report a problem with Taqwa, what to check when a prayer time looks wrong, and how your data is handled.

privacy.title: Privacy policy · Taqwa
privacy.description: What Taqwa stores on your phone, the one thing it uses the internet for, and what it never does.

timetable.index_lede: This month and next for {count} cities, calculated exactly as the app calculates them. Anywhere else, the app works wherever you are.

timetable.clock_change: The clocks change on {date}; from then on the times are on the new clock ({offset}).
timetable.stale: This timetable is out of date. The app always has today’s times.

timetable.home_lede: Timetables for {count} cities, from the same engine as the app.
timetable.qibla_here: The Kaaba is here, in the Masjid al-Haram.
timetable.ramadan_isha: In Ramadan, {method} puts {isha} two hours after {maghrib} rather than an hour and a half, and these times follow it.

timetable.not_affiliated_any: Taqwa is not affiliated with any of them.
timetable.no_copy: Taqwa ships no copy of the table; it calculates every day again from the sun.
timetable.replays: Then Taqwa replays every checked day against {authority}’s published timetable.
timetable.ruler_caption: Where Taqwa’s {fajr} fell on each checked day, in minutes after {authority}’s
timetable.ruler_alt: A minute ruler. No checked day falls before {authority}’s minute; {p0} on the same minute, {p1} one minute after, {p2} two, {p3} three or more.
timetable.card_foot: This card is the app’s Prayer screen.| Same minutes, same countdown.
timetable.pitch_title: The same engine, in your pocket.

timetable.app_title: The same engine, in your pocket
timetable.app_body: Taqwa calls you to every prayer in {city}, works offline, and never shows an ad. These exact minutes, and the adhan when they arrive.

timetable.app_point_widgets: Widgets| with the next prayer and a live countdown

timetable.app_point_free: Free forever.| No ads, no account, no tracking
